To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) we develop knowledge flow, a new method that moves ‘knowledge’ (i.e., parameters) from multiple teachers, trained on entirely different datasets and tasks, to a new student model.

(1) knowledge flow improves the student model, (2) the student model is independent of the knowledge flow teachers and (3) knowledge flow is applicable to a variety of supervised learning and reinforcement learning problems

knowledge flow is a novel knowledge transfer method that can move ‘knowledge’ from one deep net to another deep net, and that knowledge flow outperforms fine-tuning and all other ‘knowledge exchange methods’.
